rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an animal spending the winter in a dormant state.

example.english: The turtle has to hibernate all winter and only wakes up in spring.
example.traditional: 隻龜冬眠成個冬天，春天先至醒返。
example.jyutping: zek3 gwai1 dung1 min4 seng4 go3 dung1 tin1 ceon1 tin1 sin1 zi3 seng2 faan1

rows.note: Use this for a computer entering its power-saving hibernation state, rather than for an animal's winter dormancy.

example.english: The computer will automatically hibernate when it is idle for a while, saving power.
example.traditional: 部電腦閒置一陣就會自動休眠，慳返啲電。
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 nou5 haan4 zi3 jat1 zan6 zau6 wui5 zi6 dung6 jau1 min4 haan1 faan2 di1 din6
